content.short: ChainAegis is an on-chain security analysis tool offering risk warning, protocol ranking, and real-time monitoring with customizable rules.
content.description: ChainAegis is an on-chain security analysis platform developed by SharkTeam. It offers real-time monitoring and alerts for blockchain transactions to identify risky addresses and transactions. The system features extensive address labeling, including fraud and ransomware risk types, enabling comprehensive risk detection. It provides 24/7 address monitoring with timely alerts for suspicious activity and supports customizable monitoring rules to meet AML/KYT requirements.
